blocks.content: Quiz: What does the value prop on ThemeContext.Provider control?
Tap an option below to answer:
It sets the default value used when createContext() is first called
The default value in createContext() only applies when there is no Provider above the consumer.
The default value in createContext() only applies when there is no Provider above the consumer.
It defines what any useContext(ThemeContext) call in the tree receives
The value prop is the data contract. Whatever you put there is exactly what consumers get back.
The value prop is the data contract. Whatever you put there is exactly what consumers get back.
It determines which components are allowed to consume the context
Any component inside the Provider can consume the context.
Any component inside the Provider can consume the context.
It prevents the Provider from re-rendering when state changes
Changing state in the Provider causes a re-render, which updates the value for all consumers.
Changing state in the Provider causes a re-render, which updates the value for all consumers.
